title: ci(release): add the dispatch-only next snapshot lane (ADR-0125 amendment)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiNjyvCdXYygFqntMNR7S2dW)_
Part of #30591
Ruling-ref: 6663894403
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Release 工作流新增一条只能手动触发的 `next` 快照通道。勾选 `snapshot_next` 并在 `release` 环境批准后,它把 main 上最新一个全量测试在本提交上全绿的版本,以 `0.0.0-next-时间戳` 发布到 npm 的 `next` 标签。不打 git tag,不建 GitHub Release,不碰 Version Packages PR,不动 `latest`。
- **为什么改**:ADR-0125 的 2026-11-05 修订(#29466 的裁决)要求:应用方当天就需要的修复,可以先装 `next`,不必等下一个稳定版;用 `latest` 的用户没有任何变化。
- **风险与回滚**:快照触发与稳定通道互斥。稳定通道三个 job 的 `if:` 只做减法,另有自测钉住。审批页上的任务名与稳定发布的提示不同,不会被当成稳定发布批准。回滚就是 revert 本 PR;已发布的快照只占 `next`,下一次稳定发布会把 `next` 移回稳定版。注意:`@objectstack/service-push` 还没在 npm 首发,在稳定通道首发它之前,本通道会拒绝发布(这是设计要求)。
- **先看**:① `.github/workflows/release.yml`:文件末尾两个新 job,以及 `release-integrity` / `full-battery` / `publish` 三处新增的 `!inputs.snapshot_next`;② `scripts/ci/snapshot-next.mjs`:`guard` 与首发规则 `debutRefusals`;③ `scripts/release-snapshot-publish.sh`:唯一的发布命令行。
- **两分钟验证**:运行 `node scripts/ci/snapshot-next.mjs --self-test`,预期最后一行是 `snapshot-next: self-test OK -- 68 case(s) across 11 batteries`。
- **需要你做的**:等席位的独立契约评审通过后,审阅并合并本 PR(`release.yml` 是受管面)。

## What changes

ADR-0125's `## Amendment (2026-11-05, #29466)` lists what the lane must satisfy. Each item and where this PR meets it:

- **Dispatch-only and exclusive.** A new `workflow_dispatch` input, `snapshot_next` (boolean, default false), selects the lane. `release-integrity`, the stable `full-battery` gate (force branch) and `publish` (force branch) now also require `!inputs.snapshot_next`. These are strictly subtractive `if:` edits, the same shape as `!inputs.refresh_version_pr`. The two new jobs run only on `workflow_dispatch && inputs.snapshot_next && !inputs.refresh_version_pr`. `stale-prompts`, `version-pr` and `docker` are unchanged. A snapshot dispatch therefore queues no stable prompt that the stale-prompt sweep could not reach. Combined inputs:
  - snapshot + refresh runs `version-pr` only, following the existing refresh-wins precedent.
  - snapshot + force runs the snapshot lane only; `force` is never read there.
- **The commit, distance zero.** `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` gains machine-readable output:
  - `--json`: stdout carries exactly one JSON record and prose goes to stderr.
  - `--require-distance-zero`: refuses unless each gate workflow's deciding run is ON the release commit.
  - `--snapshot-commit --from SHA`: walks main's first-parent history and picks the newest commit at which both CI and Lint & Type Check decide green at distance zero.
  - `releaseGateVerdict` now also returns `chosen` rows and `distanceZero`. The stable `--release-gate` output and verdict are unchanged when the new flag is absent.
  - The preflight selects the commit with `--snapshot-commit`, confirms it with `--release-gate --release-commit C --require-distance-zero --json`, and checks the record with `jq`. The publish job checks out exactly that commit and re-asserts that it is an ancestor of `origin/main`.
- **Not during an RC cycle.** `snapshot-next.mjs preflight` refuses when `.changeset/pre.json` exists with `mode: pre` (`preModeRefusal`).
- **Workspace only.** The publish job runs the bare `pnpm exec changeset version --snapshot next` (never `pnpm run version`) and asserts the version is `0.0.0-next-` followed by 14 digits. It commits nothing, and its checkout holds no push credential (`persist-credentials: false`, `contents: read`). It then runs `bash scripts/release-snapshot-publish.sh`, whose one publish line is `changeset publish --tag next --no-git-tag`. The script is preceded by the same `check-published-dist-tooling --no-build` refusal the stable publish runs. There is no tag push, no GitHub Release and no Version Packages PR write.
- **The guard and the debut rule.** `scripts/ci/snapshot-next.mjs` (new, with `--self-test`):
  - `preflight` reads every member of the 109-package fixed group on npm (abbreviated packument). It refuses on any member with no version (`debutRefusals`), and fails closed on any unread member. Today that is `@objectstack/service-push`.
  - `guard` runs before the publish. It checks that:
    - the fixed group equals the publishable set, and every member is at one snapshot version;
    - no `publishConfig.tag`, `.npmrc` `tag=` or `npm_config_tag` overrides the tag (no value is printed);
    - the `changeset publish-plan` covers the whole group;
    - every packed manifest (`changeset pack`, so pnpm has substituted `workspace:`) carries the snapshot version, holds no `workspace:` range, and has every intra-group range satisfied by the snapshot.
  - `verify` runs after the publish. It reads `next` back at the snapshot version and treats any `latest` move onto a snapshot as an incident. ⛔ Nothing in the lane writes `latest`.
- **The approval screen.** `snapshot-next` is held at `environment: release`. Its name is `Snapshot next of main COMMIT (awaiting approval)`, and the self-test pins that it does not match `PUBLISH_JOB_NAME` from `release-pending-publish.mjs`. It has its own concurrency group, `release-snapshot-next-REF` with `cancel-in-progress: false`, so a waiting snapshot never holds `release-publish-REF`.
- **The dry run.** `node scripts/ci/snapshot-next.mjs dry-run` runs the preflight, the version step and the guard's pack. It prints each package with its version, dist-tag and intra-group ranges, then restores the tree. It publishes nothing and reads no token. The preflight job runs it on every snapshot dispatch, before approval.
- **Docs.** The release-channels table in `docs/releases-maintenance.md` gains the snapshot `next` row, plus a paragraph on sort order and on AI seats never dispatching the lane.
- **Gates that read release.yml.**
  - `scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs`: pins for the declared inputs and the job roster (eight jobs), and the mutation anchor for `release-integrity`'s guard.
  - `.github/workflows/lint.yml`: wires `snapshot-next.mjs --self-test` (step id `snapshot-lane-guard-self-test`).

## Tests

- `node scripts/ci/snapshot-next.mjs --self-test`: 68 cases across 11 batteries. Coverage includes:
  - Pre-mode refusal, debut refusal, tag overrides, plan and packed-manifest problems, and the verify incident rules.
  - Mutation cases on the real release.yml and the publish script. Each fires when an `if:` negation, the environment, the name shape, the bare version command or the publish line is removed or reshaped.
  - Exclusivity evaluated through fleet-write's own `jobsStartedBy` over every event and input combination. Push, schedule, repair, force and refresh never reach the snapshot jobs. A snapshot dispatch reaches no stable job.
- `node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test`: a new battery, "release gate: distance zero and the snapshot commit, machine-readable" (11 cases). The battery floor was raised from 7 to 8. On the recorded fixture, the stable gate verdict is unchanged.
- `pnpm check:pm-fleet-write-validate`: 329 cases pass with the updated pins.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance item 1 (the dry run) is met. Its output is below.
- Acceptance item 2 (the first real snapshot's `npm view` reading) waits for `@objectstack/service-push` to debut through the stable lane, which is why this PR says `Part of`.
- Version shape: changesets v3 with no snapshot template yields `0.0.0-next-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS`. The docs table spells that shape.
- The publish job also runs `release-spec-changes.sh --generate` and then `--verify`, so the spec tarball ships its two ADR-0087 projections, as the stable publish does. The snapshot lane builds no Docker image, runs no dist-tag sweep and cuts no GitHub Release.
- The dry run owns the tree while it runs. It refuses a dirty tree, then restores tracked paths with `git restore` and removes only the untracked files it created.
